nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Zero-waste initiatives|Swap and share programs_qna_000
nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: What are some alternatives to acquiring garments that CFC provides to consumers?
nodes.answer: CFC provides consumers with alternatives like swapping, sharing, and renting garments.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Zero-waste initiatives|Swap and share programs_qna_001
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How do swapping, sharing, and renting garments contribute to the concept of a circular fashion economy?
nodes.answer: Swapping, sharing, and renting garments contribute to a circular fashion economy by promoting the reuse and sharing of clothing items, reducing waste and promoting sustainability.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Zero-waste initiatives|Swap and share programs_qna_002
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What is the clothes swapping phenomenon, and how does it impact consumers and suppliers?
nodes.answer: The clothes swapping phenomenon refers to a trend where consumers exchange clothing items with each other instead of purchasing new ones. This practice allows consumers to refresh their wardrobe without spending money and reduces waste in the fashion industry. In this way, consumers become suppliers by offering their own pre-loved items for exchange.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Zero-waste initiatives|Swap and share programs_qna_003
nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: Why were physical swaps halted during the pandemic?
nodes.answer: Physical swaps were halted during the pandemic due to hygiene and exposure concerns driving the reduction in sharing clothing with individuals outside the household.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Zero-waste initiatives|Swap and share programs_qna_004
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What challenges are faced when transitioning to online swapping?
nodes.answer: Transitioning to online swapping poses challenges related to competences, such as finding swapping communities with different rules and regulations, as well as trust issues regarding the promised quality and delivery of items, which may be difficult to replicate face-to-face.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Zero-waste initiatives|Swap and share programs_qna_005
nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: Can you provide an example of how some individuals were still able to continue exchanging clothes during the pandemic?
nodes.answer: Some individuals continued exchanging clothes during the pandemic through virtual means, such as organizing online swapping events or using social media platforms to facilitate exchanges.
